Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan, on the other hand, were nice post Lunch. Naseem Shah bowled with venom as he picked up three while Afridi and Abbas did pretty decently as well. They though have a tough job in their hands and will need to bat out of their skins if they want to make a fist of this game. 373 on any pitch is not easy to chase but we hope that Pakistan give a tough fight to the Kiwis. Join us for Pakistan's second innings in a while.

New Zealand came out to bat after Lunch with intent! They were attacking from ball one and despite losing wickets at regular intervals, they have given a target of 373 to Pakistan. Tom Latham and Tom Blundell were the stars with the bat while there were valuable contributions from Kane Williamson and the others as well. They will back themselves now to bowl out Pakistan and take a 1-0 lead in this series.

New Zealand have declared just a few minutes before Tea break! They will be pretty happy with what they have achieved. They will now look to pick up quick wickets before Tea and put pressure on Pakistan. Overall, a very good performance from New Zealand.

... Day 4, Session 2 ...

Right then! Pakistan would hope that they can pick up quick wickets if they want to stand a chance in this game while New Zealand would look to continue churning out the runs and build on their lead. An exciting second session awaits us. Join us at around 1340 local (0040 GMT) for the second session.

Pakistan, on the other hand, have struggled. None of their bowlers have looked threatening and they have been punished. Shaheen Afridi and Mohammad Abbas bowled well at the start as they found the edges at the start but that did not go to hand. Naseem Shah and Yasir Shah tried their best but mostly struggled against the batsmen. They need to come back stronger now.

Tom Blundell and Tom Latham came out to bat in a positive manner. They looked for runs straightaway and they have batted with intent. Latham has played the second fiddle to Blundell. Blundell has mixed aggression with caution and has played some wonderful shots. Latham started slow but has started to get going now and both look settled at the crease and New Zealand will want them to continue the momentum gained.

An excellent session for New Zealand! They have scored at more than 3 runs an over and have swelled their lead to 290 which is already a good one on this wicket. Everything that they had planned has worked and they will go into the break happy.
